must.title: Seal3/Run3 field value sources unpublished
must.problem: §9 claims to be the normative mapping to seal and Run bytes. Evidence3 and policy-derivation3 have field lists. Seal3/Run3 are deferred to existing identity recipes plus identifier plus verdict=proof.verdict. Schema required keys do not assign values. Identity-and-evidence §3 gives H(D,X), not the proof/Plan/snapshot joins. A normative-only consumer cannot reproduce seal/run bytes without reading replay/seal_derived.
must.correction: Publish Seal3 and Run3 field tables. Seal: planId=proof.planId; executionPlanId=proof.executionPlanId; evidenceId=H(semantic-evidence, evidence3); evaluatorClosure=proof.evaluatorClosure; policyDigest=Plan.policyDigest; proofBundleId=H(proof-bundle, proof); verdict=proof.verdict. Run: projectId=snapshot.projectId; snapshotId=Plan.snapshotId; planId=proof.planId; evidenceId=seal.evidenceId; evaluationSealId=H(evaluation-seal, seal3); capabilityManifestId=Plan.capabilityManifestId (capability-manifest-id recipe).

must.title: identifier helper named as field law
must.problem: §9.7 says Evidence, seal and Run H ids are identifier of those descriptors. identifier is identity-model.v3.identifier. Field law is H(D,X) in identity-and-evidence §3.
must.correction: State H(D,X)=prefix(D)+':'+hex(SHA256(ASCII('opensip.product.v1') || 00 || ASCII(D) || 00 || uint64BE(len(C(X))) || C(X))) with prefix from x-opensip-prefix. Apply to finding3, proof3, evidence3, seal3, run3, policy-derivation3, subject3, finding-key2. Do not name identifier.

must.title: Description names RuleProgramV1
must.problem: program-predicate description says admitted RuleProgramV1. ruleProgramDigest annotation selector and composition §9.1/§9.3 use RuleProgramV2. Every witness hashes this record.
must.correction: Replace RuleProgramV1 with RuleProgramV2 in that description only. Do not add a second program identity.
